# Aurum Ghana Website

## Overview
Aurum Ghana is a luxury Ghanaian jewelry e-commerce platform offering gold, silver, diamond, beaded, and traditional African-inspired jewelry pieces.

## Pages
- Homepage (index.html) - Hero, featured products, categories
- Category (category.html) - Product listing with filters
- Product (product.html) - Product detail page
- Cart (cart.html) - Shopping cart
- Checkout (checkout.html) - Order checkout
- Login/Register - Authentication pages
- Account - User profile management
- Admin - Dashboard and management

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
- No framework dependencies
- Backend API integration via api.js client
